item.title: High Hopes Crew Lands Record-Setting 832.6-Pound Virginia Bluefin Tuna with PENN Gear
item.description: A new Virginia saltwater record is on the books after angler Mike Rogerson landed an 832.6-pound Atlantic bluefin tuna aboard High Hopes with PENN Fleet Captain David Wright. The massive bluefin was caught off Virginia Beach and fought for 90 minutes on trusted PENN gear. The post High Hopes Crew Lands Record-Setting 832.6-Pound Virginia Bluefin Tuna with PENN Gear first appeared on Coastal Angler & The Angler Magazine.
